name: Yang dimension of Singletons
proof: For the delta-function class, distinct nonempty subfamilies have distinct least containing cubes, so the Taylor resolution of Yang's canonical ideal is minimal. Its top syzygy has homological degree $n-1$, which is therefore the Yang dimension.
references: \cite{yang2018homological}; see the full arXiv version, Section "Delta Functions", which constructs the minimal $(n-1)$-simplex resolution of the delta-function class.
